project: Apollo (band-sequence modeling for high-quality audio restoration) - reproduction

paper.title: Apollo: Band-sequence Modeling for High-Quality Audio Restoration
paper.eval_scale_in_paper: 5000 samples per case on combined MUSDB18-HQ + MoisesDB test set

key_commits.5da8da2: single-GPU config, offline wandb, slurm launcher
key_commits.fcd5865: fix validation_step unpacking for 3-tuple eval batch

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada Generation (49 GB, single GPU)

data.train_sources: MUSDB18-HQ train (100 tracks) + MoisesDB (240 tracks), 11 stems + mixture
data.notes: MoisesDB came from Kaggle mirror boyazhangnb/moisesdb; MD5 differs from official (re-zipped), content verified

training_config.model: STFT 20/10 ms, 80 bands, feature_dim 256, B=6 bands-sequence blocks, 16.5M params
training_config.discriminator: 7 STFT scales [32..2048], complex RI input, spectral norm

39556.note: resume verified on real ckpt; plateau after epoch 8

diagnosis.root_cause_of_first_run_failure: L_G backward accumulated dL_G/dD into D gradient buffers under 8-step accumulation; D was trained to minimise L_G and collapsed to a constant output
diagnosis.evidence: D(real)==D(fake) to 4 decimals (0.6467/0.6467), L_FM collapsed to 0.0002, output was near-identity (est-vs-codec 15-20 dB)
diagnosis.fix: discriminator.requires_grad_(False) around manual_backward(loss_g); regression test tests/test_grad_accum.py

verdict.reason: only 10/500 epochs, single GPU, 50 clips (paper: 5000/case), no ViSQOL, no SR-GAN comparison
